notes.subject: Kristy call notes — handwritten outreach history
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Whittle the Wood Rendezvous, 970-826-2029. Gmail history adds important context: in June 2025 Alicia Baker said the event had already secured a company from Vernal, Utah, but invited Adventure Zone to apply to be the bounce-house vendor the following year. The official 2026 event ran June 18-20 at the Moffat County Fairgrounds and remained a large family event. Preserve as relationship history, not a cold lead.

followUps.label: 2027 booking follow-up
followUps.reason: The event previously invited Adventure Zone to apply the following year. Check the 2027 vendor/entertainment process early and avoid missing the application window.
